name: Natsu no Shizuku
source:
Summer. The scorching sun shined upon us.
"It's been a while... Shi-chan"
The summer girl, and the ten years older me... the story of our promise.

[From [url=http://hanikamuaisuman.web.fc2.com/game/n/n.html]homepage[/url]]
translation:
夏天。炎炎烈日照耀着我们。“好久不见了……小诗”夏日的女孩，和十年后的我……关于我们约定的故事。

[来自[url=http://hanikamuaisuman.web.fc2.com/game/n/n.html]主页[/url]]
